postState.name: TPO Prior-Value Momentum
postState.description: Routes on a curated twelve-signal momentum scorecard whose per-signal scores were read live at 1h before the gate was set. Eleven advisory prior-session TPO conditions, ordered rarest-first so no row masks another, tell the model where price sits against yesterday value area. TPO feeds no signal module and cannot score; it shapes what the agent reads, not what the router computes.
postState.tagline: Curated momentum scorecard at a 0.65 floor; prior TPO value shapes the read.
postState.marketReadText: THESIS, UNMEASURED ON THIS PLATFORM: when today's developing point of control (POC) moves clear of yesterday's value area, price tends to continue in that direction. No backtest exists; the 0.25% migration band was set from one day's cross-section (2026-09-12) and is being re-measured hourly. GATE, required, the platform blocks otherwise: {TPO_HAS_DIRECTION} TRUE = value migrated clear of the prior area, or the developing POC at least 0.25% off the prior one. Flat value is no trade. MEASURED: in the first hour of each UTC session the developing profile is absent and the gate reads FALSE; no trade then, by design. SETUPS, strongest first: {VALUE_ABOVE_CONFIRMED} / {VALUE_BELOW_CONFIRMED}, developing POC clear of the whole prior area ({tpoPOC_pTpoVAH_spread} to the prior high, {tpoPOC_pTpoVAL_spread} to the prior low) with the close on the right side of it ({close_tpoPOC_spread}); then {VALUE_ABOVE} / {VALUE_BELOW}; weakest, {VALUE_RISING_IN_BALANCE} / {VALUE_FALLING_IN_BALANCE}, developing POC {tpoPOC_pTpoPOC_spread} from the prior one inside the area. {VALUE_UNCHANGED_IN_BALANCE}: stand aside. LONG on UP, SHORT on DOWN, never against. CONFIGURED CONFIRMATION, the flow and trend signals this book weights: EMA5/13/20 ({EMA5}/{EMA13}/{EMA20}) aligned the same way; higher-timeframe alignment ({MAalign_htf}); sustained MFI14 ({MFI14}); open-interest divergence ({OI}) against the move carries the heaviest bearish weight; CVD ({CVD}); funding ({rate}) flipping. tpoShape ({tpoShape}) is POC skew inside today's value, an unmeasured read; do not lean on it. Prior width {pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread} is context, not a rule. INVALIDATION by this book's own logic: the developing POC back inside prior value, or the close back through the developing POC against the trade. CONFIGURED MANAGEMENT: 1h-close entry; stop 1-2 ATR; at least 1.5R; break-even 1.08R; trail from 1R, 45% giveback; time decay on. Size within the presets; let the scorecard choose the preset.

before.marketReadText: HOW THIS BOOK WORKS. Value migration: where today's developing value is building against yesterday's completed value area. When the developing point of control (POC) moves clear of the prior area the auction has relocated and price tends to continue that way. GATE, required, the platform blocks otherwise: {TPO_HAS_DIRECTION} TRUE = value has migrated, or the developing POC has moved at least 0.25% off the prior one. Flat value is no trade. In the first hour of each UTC session the developing profile is absent, the gate reads FALSE by design. SETUPS, strongest first. {VALUE_ABOVE_CONFIRMED} / {VALUE_BELOW_CONFIRMED}: the developing POC is clear of the whole prior area ({tpoPOC_pTpoVAH_spread} versus the prior high, {tpoPOC_pTpoVAL_spread} versus the prior low) and the close is on the right side of it ({close_tpoPOC_spread}). Next: {VALUE_ABOVE} / {VALUE_BELOW} without that confirmation. Weakest, still tradeable: {VALUE_RISING_IN_BALANCE} / {VALUE_FALLING_IN_BALANCE}, the developing POC {tpoPOC_pTpoPOC_spread} from the prior one while still inside the area. {VALUE_UNCHANGED_IN_BALANCE}: stand aside. LONG on an UP verdict, SHORT on DOWN, never against it. WHAT CONFIRMS IT, the flow and trend family this book routes on: EMA5/13/20 ({EMA5}/{EMA13}/{EMA20}) stacked in the direction of the move; the higher timeframe aligned ({MAalign_htf}); sustained MFI14 ({MFI14}) pressure; open interest ({OI}) building with price, not diverging; CVD ({CVD}) leaning the same way; funding ({rate}) not flipping against you. A p-shape ({tpoShape}) supports up-migration, a b-shape down-migration. Migration out of a wide prior area ({pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread}) is stronger. INVALIDATION: the developing POC falling back inside prior value, or the close crossing back through the developing POC against the trade. MANAGEMENT: 1h-close entry; stop 1-2 ATR; at least 1.5R; break-even 1.08R; trail from 1R, 45% giveback; time decay on. Size within the presets; let the scorecard choose the preset.

reviewContext.intentSummary: Label the market read honestly: THESIS (unmeasured on this platform) separated from CONFIGURED and MEASURED facts, a statement that no backtest exists and thresholds came from one day's cross-section now re-measured hourly, and confirmation presented as the signals this book weights rather than as market truths. Only the marketReadText axis changes.
assumptions: Every {marker} is one of this strategy's conditionKeys or a header it renders; reviewContext.reportPreview.marketReadMarkers is checked and any status other than condition or column, any unreferenceable markerCondition, or any brace left in the rendered preview stops the run.

Every number in the text is a configured value read back from this record (gate thresholds, signal params, stops, R multiples, break-even, trailing, time decay) or a measured platform fact (first-hour absence of tpo*; the 2.06 -> 2.32 width-quartile move).
Measured 2026-09-11: UPDATE merges; only marketReadText is sent.
Scope: revision only. No binding change, no deployment, no fund allocation.
serverAssumptions: Rendered market values are a point-in-time preview and are not mutation authority.
Open-position count is timestamped awareness and does not block configuration changes.
The Sector & BTC Comparison module is not in this report, but 1 of its signal still scores — membership never gates evaluation, so those weights still count.

section.title: TPO value migration
section.text:
Positive spread means the first metric sits above the second. pTpoVAH: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAH_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs close. pTpoVAL: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAL_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAL vs close. pTpoPOC: the price bin that held the most time in the previous completed UTC session. pTpoPOC_close_spread: % gap pTpoPOC vs close. pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs pTpoVAL. pTpoVAL_open_spread: % gap pTpoVAL vs open. tpoPOC: the price bin holding the most time in the current UTC session, over 5-bps bins — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the session's first 60 minutes. tpoPOC_pTpoVAH_spread: % gap tpoPOC vs pTpoVAH. tpoPOC_pTpoVAL_spread: % gap tpoPOC vs pTpoVAL. tpoPOC_pTpoPOC_spread: % gap tpoPOC vs pTpoPOC. close: the bar's close price. close_tpoPOC_spread: % gap close vs tpoPOC. tpoVAH: the upper edge of the 70% value area around the current session's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the session's first 60 minutes. tpoVAH_tpoVAL_spread: % gap tpoVAH vs tpoVAL. tpoShape: where the point of control sits inside the current session's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror — a point-in-time read at its own fold (p-shape / b-shape / balanced). EMA5: 5-period exponential moving average. EMA13: 13-period exponential moving average. EMA20: 20-period exponential moving average. CVD: cumulative volume delta accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor. rate: the perpetual funding rate (%), a point-in-time read at its own sample time. MAalign: price stacked against EMA20 / SMA20 / SMA50 (bullish / bearish / mixed). MFI14: 14-period money flow index (volume-weighted RSI, 0–100). OI: open interest, USD notional — a point-in-time read at its own sample time.

marketReadPreview.gridText: THESIS, UNMEASURED ON THIS PLATFORM: when today's developing point of control (POC) moves clear of yesterday's value area, price tends to continue in that direction. No backtest exists; the 0.25% migration band was set from one day's cross-section (2026-09-12) and is being re-measured hourly. GATE, required, the platform blocks otherwise: TPO_HAS_DIRECTION TRUE = value migrated clear of the prior area, or the developing POC at least 0.25% off the prior one. Flat value is no trade. MEASURED: in the first hour of each UTC session the developing profile is absent and the gate reads FALSE; no trade then, by design. SETUPS, strongest first: VALUE_ABOVE_CONFIRMED / VALUE_BELOW_CONFIRMED, developing POC clear of the whole prior area (tpoPOC_pTpoVAH_spread to the prior high, tpoPOC_pTpoVAL_spread to the prior low) with the close on the right side of it (close_tpoPOC_spread); then VALUE_ABOVE / VALUE_BELOW; weakest, VALUE_RISING_IN_BALANCE / VALUE_FALLING_IN_BALANCE, developing POC tpoPOC_pTpoPOC_spread from the prior one inside the area. VALUE_UNCHANGED_IN_BALANCE: stand aside. LONG on UP, SHORT on DOWN, never against. CONFIGURED CONFIRMATION, the flow and trend signals this book weights: EMA5/13/20 (EMA5/EMA13/EMA20) aligned the same way; higher-timeframe alignment (MAalign_htf); sustained MFI14 (MFI14); open-interest divergence (OI) against the move carries the heaviest bearish weight; CVD (CVD); funding (rate) flipping. tpoShape (tpoShape) is POC skew inside today's value, an unmeasured read; do not lean on it. Prior width pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread is context, not a rule. INVALIDATION by this book's own logic: the developing POC back inside prior value, or the close back through the developing POC against the trade. CONFIGURED MANAGEMENT: 1h-close entry; stop 1-2 ATR; at least 1.5R; break-even 1.08R; trail from 1R, 45% giveback; time decay on. Size within the presets; let the scorecard choose the preset.
